ShortDescription.Value: Snow overlays, tire tracks, footprints and snowbanks for Cities: Skylines II.

Publish.ChangeLog: Improved intersection geometry, curb coverage, snow lighting and LOD transitions. Traffic wear preserves compacted snow between cleaner wheel paths; motorcycles leave one central track. Reduced unnecessary track-history processing and GPU page-table uploads. Improved snowbank stability and added experimental realistic snow, enabled by default for new settings.
